# DataDuel.co

> > Analytics blog exploring modern data tools like DuckDB, MotherDuck, dbt, and LLM integration in SQL workflows

DataDuel.co is written by Jacob Matson and Nate Sooter, analytics consultants sharing practical insights on data engineering, career development, and emerging technologies. The site features hands-on tutorials, tool comparisons, and real-world applications of Python, SQL, and AI-enhanced analytics.

## Key Topics

- DuckDB
- MotherDuck
- dbt (data build tool)
- LLM evaluation and integration
- SQL and Python
- GitHub Actions
- Data visualization (Tableau, Power BI)
- Analytics career paths
- AI-enhanced development
- Docker and containerization
- Dashboard design best practices
- CRM data cleanup
- Model benchmarking
- Gemini models
- Analytics consulting

## About & Core

- [DataDuel.co – Analytics-Adjacent Ideas & Musings](https://www.dataduel.co): Homepage featuring analytics musings, LLM evaluation, and Gemini models
- [About – DataDuel.co](https://www.dataduel.co/about): About Jacob Matson, Nate Sooter, and their analytics consulting work

## Analytics Career Guidance

- [Landing Your First Analytics Job](https://www.dataduel.co/landing-your-first-analytics-job): Career advice for entry-level analytics jobs with SQL and Python skills
- [Defining Analytics Titles](https://www.dataduel.co/defining-analytics-titles): Guide to analytics job roles: data scientist, analyst, engineer careers
- [The Many Wandering Paths to Analytics](https://www.dataduel.co/the-many-wandering-paths-to-analytics): Career transitions and non-linear paths into analytics roles

## Modern Data Tools & Engineering

- [LLMs in SQL? A real-world application to clean up your CRM data](https://www.dataduel.co/llms-in-sql-a-real-world-application-to-clean-up-your-crm-data): Using GPT-4o in MotherDuck SQL for CRM data cleanup and classification
- [Revisiting data query speed with DuckDB](https://www.dataduel.co/revisiting-data-query-speed-with-duckdb): DuckDB performance benchmarking vs SQL Server for Wordle analysis
- [Simple dbt runner](https://www.dataduel.co/simple-dbt-runner): Cost-efficient dbt runner using GitHub Actions and AWS S3 state storage
- [Exploring AI-Enhanced Development: My Experience with Codeium's Windsurf IDE](https://www.dataduel.co/exploring-ai-enhanced-development-my-experience-with-codiums-windsurf-ide): Review of Windsurf IDE building MotherDuck Terraform provider project

## Data Visualization & Dashboards

- [Write Code Last - 4 steps to better dashboards](https://www.dataduel.co/write-code-last-4-steps-to-better-dashboards): Dashboard design best practices: plan before coding visualizations
- [Duel: NBA Bubble Projections](https://www.dataduel.co/duel-nba-bubble-projections): Power BI vs Tableau comparison replicating FiveThirtyEight NBA predictions

## Technical Tutorials
